speaker: Doctor
text:
I understand you are an infant brought in by your mother due to bilious vomiting and an inability to pass meconium, accompanied by abdominal distension. To confirm my suspicion of intestinal obstruction, I need to know your exact age in days and if you have ever passed any stool or gas since birth.

REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Dilated loops of bowel with no gas in the rectum, suggestive of a distal obstruction.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The X-ray confirms a distal intestinal obstruction with no gas in the rectum. Given your age and symptoms, do you have a family history of Hirschsprung's disease, and does the vomiting contain any bile (green/yellow color)?

REQUEST TEST: Rectal_Swab

speaker: Doctor
text: The abdominal X-ray shows dilated loops of bowel with no gas in the rectum, confirming a distal obstruction. Based on the bilious vomiting and failure to pass meconium, I suspect Hirschsprung disease. Please confirm if the rectal swab for the suction biopsy showed ganglion cells or if there was a lack of muscle relaxation upon examination. REQUEST TEST: Rectal_Swab

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Abnormal findings; absence of ganglion cells in the submucosa and myenteric plexus noted, consistent with Hirschsprung's disease.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy results confirming the absence of ganglion cells in the submucosa and myenteric plexus are diagnostic for Hirschsprung's disease. DIAGNOSIS READY: Hirschsprung's Disease
